scope: Forward-time USD/JPY midpoint direction forecasts only. No real orders, paper fills, trading decisions or changes to existing live trading defaults.

tests.review: Read-only reviewer identified floating-point midpoint drift in baseline directions; hand-checked regression first failed, then passed after integer half-tick comparison. Follow-up review confirmed correction and bounded recovery, with no additional actionable issues.

initialFailure.rootCause: Initial statusless exception subtype was not retained, so exact initial cause is unproven. Eight bounded diagnostic replays of the last input all passed validation and were not scored.
initialFailure.change: Added safe categorical diagnostics and bounded fresh-input recovery for invalid forecast or whitelisted SDK parse/schema errors. Strict validation retained; invalid answers never become committed predictions. New live run recorded three local invalid forecasts and two SDK response-data errors and recovered.

limitations: Only three minutes of forecast collection: a technical pilot, not a tradable-edge or profitability test.
Raw forecasts overlap; 368 predictions per horizon are not independent market samples. Nonoverlap counts are132,34,6,3 and still not guaranteed independent.
Uses local receipt-time horizons and midpoint direction. Does not test move size, execution, costs, or positions.
Failed and cancelled requests are excluded from accuracy, disclosed separately; all baselines share the successful eligible sample.
Reported API cost covers successful committed requests in the final run only, excluding initial run, eight diagnostic calls, failures and cancellation. Actual billing is unknown.
No model or horizon tuning was performed in response to scores. Poor results here do not prove all Jev forecasting applications impossible.
